bullets.text: Translated business requirements into maintainable technical solutions while coordinating priorities across product, operations, and engineering stakeholders.
Improved system reliability by troubleshooting incidents, documenting root causes, and implementing repeatable fixes for recurring technical issues.
Used SQL, Python, Git, and structured testing practices to validate changes, improve data quality, and support reliable releases.
Collaborated in agile delivery cycles to estimate work, communicate risks, review acceptance criteria, and ship incremental improvements.
